slides.fact: Bent knees plus twists and sudden loads tire the thighs fast

sections.heading: 1. Leg strength + balance
lines: ① Squats and split squats, 10 × 3 sets.
② Wall sits, 30 sec × 3, build up slowly.
③ Single-leg balance 30 sec, side lunges.
④ Keep each knee in line with your toes.

sections.heading: 2. Get it checked if…
lines: A pop with swelling, or the knee gives way,
on the mountain or once you're home.

caption:
Japan ski trip booked? A few weeks of prep can make day three feel a lot better.

Skiing and snowboarding keep you in a bent-knee position for long runs, with twists and sudden loads. After a Sydney summer, most legs aren't used to that, so thighs tire and knees work harder.

Start four to six weeks out with two or three leg sessions a week: squats, split squats, wall sits and single-leg balance. Build up gradually and keep day one shorter.

A pop with swelling, a knee that gives way or locks, or being unable to take weight is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can set a pre-trip plan. Book online via the link in bio.
